name: Barry Styles
source:
Barry is flamboyant yet chill, fun yet empathetic. Untouchably cool and yet, somehow, one of your biggest fans. He loves drama but is mostly and observer, content to skate over the 'face' of whatever's happening. He comes off quite confident, but internally, is more than a little nervous about being replaced. He can sometimes be a little ditzy, though, if anyone is self-aware it's him (prepare for parentheticals, darling).

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
